tei:titleStmt.tei:title: de nas chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams ca
de nas chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams ca

tei:div.tei:p: )de nas chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum dang*// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /lan gsum brjod/

sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan cing mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ de nas rgyal ba 'khor bcas bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan 'dren pa ni/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag la// thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// de nas khrus gsol ba'i thog mar khrus khang bskyed cing snyan brnan pa ni/

khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas khrus bgyi'o// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyang phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus bgyi'o// sku phyi ba ni// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// gos 'bul ba ni/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /bzhugs su gsol ba ni// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// de nas yan lag bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi// 'char ka'i pad+ma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba// lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas// lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal// bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho// phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs dus gsum gshegs pa yi// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rnams la=

/snang ba dam pa 'od mi 'khrugs pa dang*// dpa' bo 'jigs skyob gzhon nu rol pa che// rdo rje 'chang dang dpa' bo stobs ldan pa// lha yi yul byon drug la= /drang srong khros rgyal gser 'od dam pa dang*// brtse ba'i rnam rol 'od srung bsgres po'i zhabs// mngon rdzogs rgyal po shākya seng ge ste// mi yi yul byon drug la= /rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba// mgon po mchog gyur khyod la= /mar me mdzad sogs rgyal ba 'das pa dang*// byang chub chen por da lta bzhugs pa dang*// byams pa la sogs slad nas 'byon pa yi// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la= /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang*// shākya thub pa gau taṃ lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la= /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing*// spyod pa spyad tshe na yang mched gyur la// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la= /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med// chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub// rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la= /mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni// dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs// thugs rje bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston// rdo rje sems dpa' che la= /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la= /kun bzang rigs lnga sems dpa' yab yum dang*// thub drug sgo ba khro rgyal yab yum bcu// gnas yul ma mo dbang phyug sgo skyong sogs// dam pa rigs brgya'i tshogs la= /yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka

/che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la= /'dus pa bde dgyes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*// gdan bzhi mā ya thod pa gshin rje gshed// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs sngags rgyud kyi// ye shes lha tshogs kun la= /gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya'i rigs 'byung la sogs sngags kyi lha// zhi khro'i lha tshogs rgyud sde bzhi po las// gang gsungs rnams la gus pas= /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la= /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad// ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung*// skyes rabs rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la= /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la= /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa// rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la= /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa'i// dgra bcom gnas brtan rnams la= /sha ri'i bu dang mauṅgal gyi bu// kun dga' sgra gcan 'dzin dang ma 'gags pa// gang po rab 'byor 'od srung nye 'khor sogs// nyan thos grangs las 'das la= /rgyun bzhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs// dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu zung bzhi dang*// tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la= /bkra shis 'byung dang byang chub chen po dang*// chos 'khor cho 'phrul chen po lha las babs// dbyen bzlums sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs// myang 'das mchod rten rnams la=

/dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī seng ye shes mdo// mkhas pa nyer gcig rigs can drwa ma lnga// rgyal po dzaḥdang bde ba'i 'khor lo sogs// rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la= /hūm̐ mdzad 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bi ma la// pra bha hasti dha na saṃ skṛ ta// nā ga rdzu na gu h+ya tsan+d+ra dang*// shīn+taṃ gar+bha rnams la= /in+d+ra bhu ti bi rū sa ra ha// lo hi nag po pa dang dril bu pa// sangs rgyas gsang ba sgeg pa rdo rje sogs// dpag yas grub chen rnams la= /mgon po klu sgrub ār+ya de wa dang*// thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags// chos skyong yon shāka rnam gnyis dpa' bo sogs// 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la= /'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsug /kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me sbar// ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras gcig pu// mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la= /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos rigs brgya'i bdag /phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'khor los bsgyur ba po// snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i mthu stobs can// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la= /byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal tshul 'dzin cing*// gangs can khrod 'dir gdul bya ma lus pa// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yi// khri srong lde'u btsan zhabs la= /nam snying sangs rgyas ye shes rgyal mchog dbyangs// mtsho rgyal ye shes gzhon nu dpal seng ge /'brog mi dpal ye bai ro la sogs pa'i// grub brnyes rje 'bangs rnams la= /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos la sogs pa// 'gro ba'i don du tshul bzhin bsgyur dang spel// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba cher mdzad pa'i// lo paṇa skyes mchog rnams la= /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa'i srog /nges don lam bzang gsal mdzad so dang gnubs// smra ba'i dbang phyug rong zom chos bzang sogs// bka' gter bla ma rnams la= /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag shākya 'byung gnas dang*// he ru ka dpal zur chung shes rab grags// gsang bdag dpa' bo shākya seng ge ste// zur pa mes dbon gsum la=

/'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*// thugs rje lung rtogs mnyam pa'i mthu mnga' yang*// nags khrod dam par sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// 'khor 'das chos skur rdzogs pa'i klong chen pa// dri med 'od zer zhabs la= /nyang ral chos dbang rgod kyi ldem 'phru can// o rgyan sangs rgyas rdo rje rat+na gling*// pad+ma karma las 'phro gling pa sogs// sprul sku gter ston brgya rtsa la= /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gnas la byang chub pa// g.yung ston mnga' ris paṇa chen blo gros bzang*// shes rab 'od zer byang bdag yab sras sogs// bka' gter sgron me rnams la= /bai ro tsā na bsam bzhin srid pa'i gar// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i me ro gting nas bslangs// gangs can mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i 'khor los bsgyur// rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa la= /thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje thogs med rtsal// 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen dharma shrī// mkhas grub chen po sna tshogs rang grol sogs// gsang bstan gsal mdzad rnams la= /bka' bab bdun ldan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// rgyal bas lung bstan blo gros pha mtha' yas// smra ba'i seng ge mi pham rnam rgyal sogs// ngo mtshar shing rta rnams la= /nyan rang byang sems bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud// rnal 'byor che dang a nu a ti sogs// theg pa rim dgu'i chos tshul rgya mtsho yi// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la= /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang*// 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel gyi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la= /a ti sha sogs bka' gdams gsar rnying dang*// gong ma lnga sogs lam 'bras brgyud pa dang*// mar mi dwags sogs phyag chen chos drug dang*// rin chen bdun sogs shangs chos 'dzin rnams dang*// jo zhal la sogs dus kyi 'khor lo dang*// dam pa ma gcig la sogs zhi gcod srol// gangs can ris med rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la=

/'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// 'dzin dang spel dang bsrung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i// skyes bu dam pa rnams la= /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje yis// sgrub pa po la ma yis bu bzhin skyong*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= /gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal// nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la= /gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams la= /tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu// rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang ris mgon po ste// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes 'phags pa'i tshogs// dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ zhes sogs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pa'i bar ro/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i yan lag ni/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang zhig yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dag

/ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du 'bul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid la mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyid// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byed pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man+da ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pal la sogs dri zhim sna tshogs dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa sgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig

/dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad par 'babs par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /de nas/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che// nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog

/i dam rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad par grags so/ gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa la sogs pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ mi 'chab bo/ mi sbed do/ phyin chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyid lags so/ mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ zhes sogs so/ bzhi pa dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa yan lag phyi ma bzhi ni/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ zhes pa nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar ro// de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga ni/ sbyor ba yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song ba'i rjes su/ dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang*/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du btang nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed blangs la/ mjug tu dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// long bas phyag dar phung po las// ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar// de bzhin ji zhig ltar ltas na// byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes// zhes dang*/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig

/skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la bde 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog// /
